question: In the frozen 125-case ICASSP2022 pure-far corpus, how much of the high pre-Activity mic/reference energy ratio is already present in source-domain relative levels, how much is changed by 48-to-16-kHz boundary resampling, and how much is associated with Sync selecting a delayed reference instead of the current render frame?

selection.rule: reuse the exact frozen PR #238/#239/#240 inventory: all complete no-movement ICASSP2022 farend-singletalk mic+lpb pairs at the pinned source revision

observation_method.source_energy: mean-square energy from original 48-kHz PCM16 mic and lpb samples in each 10-ms source frame
observation_method.mic_internal_pre_hpf_energy: independent research-only stream-0 boundary resampler output, with post-HPF energy cross-checked against actual Activity mic energy as in PR #240
observation_method.render_internal_current_energy: actual production stream-2 render resampler output read from pipeline->work immediately after ap_pipeline_push_render and before capture processing reuses that scratch union
observation_method.synced_reference_energy: actual production Sync reference energy after ap_pipeline_process_capture, before any signal correction
observation_method.source_full_clip_ratio: ratio of full-clip mean source mic energy to full-clip mean source lpb energy; descriptive recording-level statistic, not an echo-path gain estimate

outputs: per-case full-clip source-domain mic/lpb energy ratio
per-case far-frame source current-frame mic/lpb ratio
per-case far-frame 16-kHz pre-HPF mic/current-render ratio before Sync selection
per-case mic and render boundary-resampler energy delta dB and their differential delta
per-case Sync reference-selection delta dB relative to the current resampled render frame
cross-case Spearman associations with public-DTD occupancy
prohibited_actions: treat source or current-frame ratios as physical echo-path gain estimates because propagation delay and nonstationarity remain present
derive or apply gain normalization from source-domain ratios
change resampler, Sync, HPF, Activity, AEC, RES, NS, AGC, or VAD source
search a DTD threshold, normalization constant, delay, filter, or sample subset
subsample or hand-pick cases after observing results
treat an association as a classifier, ranking, or source-candidate selector
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: This diagnostic may describe whether case-level high pure-far mic/reference ratios are already reflected in source recording levels, are materially changed by boundary resampling, or are associated with Sync reference selection. It cannot establish physical device gain or echo-path gain, and cannot authorize gain normalization, threshold changes, or a source candidate.
